feedback.problem: The cubic polynomial $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-1,{x}_{2,3}=\pm 4\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $2.$ Find $f(x).$
feedback.worked_solution:
Since $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1}=-1$ and ${x}_{2,3}=\pm 4\text{i},$ and the coefficient of the cubic term is $a=2,$ we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3}) \\  & =2(x-(-1))(x-4\text{i})(x-(-4\text{i})) \\  & =2(x+1)(x-4\text{i})(x+4\text{i})\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}2(x+1)(x-4\text{i})(x+4\text{i}) & = \\ 2(x+1)({x}^{2}-(4\text{i})^{2}) & = \\ 2(x+1)({x}^{2}+16) & = \\ 2({x}^{3}+{x}^{2}+16x+16) & = \\ 2{x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+32x+32 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=2{x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+32x+32.$
